scope: Independent static artifact and freeze-helper review only. No helper execution, installation, inference, grant change or actual-client acceptance.
secret_scan_scope: Known high-confidence key patterns and member allowlist; not a claim that arbitrary data can be proved secret-free. New payload files and modified source were also reviewed during implementation.

launcher.claude: bundle launch.py prepends its own src and borrows declared existing server venv
launcher.codex: unchanged thin wrapper invokes the declared source checkout through its server venv

observations: Performs identity and complete member checks before write_new freezes the release manifest.
Never installs, changes grants/dependencies, restarts clients or sends messages; copies only reviewed artifact/shared-path inputs to a new Downloads directory.
Refuses existing frozen manifest and delivery root; a mid-copy I/O failure can leave an incomplete frozen delivery requiring deliberate coordinator recovery, never a successful delivery record.
Uses Python assertions for preconditions; invoke without -O/PYTHONOPTIMIZE as the reviewed coordinator command.
release-manifest.prepared.json was not yet present during this review; its final content and shared-path selection remain coordinator responsibilities.
